reviewScope: Both recovered original full job logs and immutable exported runtime evidence; no new experiment
actualObservedFailure: Both original normal modes failed before initial menu and both following occupied modes failed waiting for ADB; final emulator console TCP5554 unavailable. Boot-time ColorBuffer errors preceded successful boot and app-data reset.
diagnosticProposal: Keep the exact signed game/observer APK bytes, AVD image, renderer options and strict QA behavior unchanged. No quality reduction, game-clock changes or blind retry.

Before the emulator starts, take timestamped /proc/meminfo and /proc/pressure/memory baselines; resolve the actual current cgroup path and record memory.current/max/peak/events/events.local and swap counters when readable. Record unavailable files and permission errors explicitly.

Sample the actual emulator/qemu processes by resolved executable path, AVD identity and PID plus starttime (not name alone): /proc/PID/status fields VmRSS/VmHWM/VmSize/Threads, stat state/PPID/starttime and process disappearance time. Use bounded 1Hz sampling until the existing job ends, with per-sample timestamps.
Capture kernel OOM records from the CI start time via dmesg or journalctl -k when permitted, plus cgroup counter deltas. A disappearing PID alone is not proof of OOM.

Exact emulator exit status requires a lightweight logging wrapper to own and wait for the unchanged original emulator command; an unrelated polling shell cannot wait for another process child. If the existing action cannot expose status, record unknown rather than guessing a signal or exit code. Do not automatically restart the emulator.

Start a read-only continuous adb logcat collector before launching the target so earlier WebView/Android failures survive later ADB loss; retain its own exit status and stderr. Do not rely solely on post-failure adb logcat.

Always export the new raw diagnostics and exact scripts with QA run/attempt/source and original package run/attempt/source/hash bindings. Preserve both prior failed reports; missing diagnostic fields stay unavailable and never count as runtime success.
